ocr.notes: Few errors: 'ides' for the year he came to St. Louis (image looks like 1868 but is smudged), 'to-wef' for 'to-day', '<4 Be arnae' for 'sportsman'.

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat reported the death of Fred Watkins, a Birmingham-born St. Louis hide and leather merchant who had backed Tom Allen when Allen was champion and was a familiar figure at ringside.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Sunday Morning, May 3, 1896, page 12.

facts.fact: Fred Watkins, a native of Birmingham, England, and partner in the St. Louis hide and leather firm Watkins & Lieber, who had backed Allen when Allen was champion, died of a stroke in St. Louis

notes: Same event as 928. Watkins, like Allen, was from Birmingham.
